source_text: The National Health Service (NHS) in England and Wales faces substantial long-term healthcare expenditures attributable to female genital mutilation (FGM), estimated at £100 million annually based on 2015/16 data, encompassing treatment for complications among an estimated 137,000 affected women and girls.
